basis.projection: Sleeper 2026 projected stat lines re-scored with The Panther Pit's exact scoring_settings (data/raw/league-pit-2026.json). NOT the draft board's numbers: the board is scored in the HBGBs' settings.
basis.market: ADP and Boris Chen tiers come from the shared draft board, which is built in this league's reception value.
basis.lineup: Optimal lineup under QB/RB/RB/WR/WR/TE/FLEX/FLEX/K/DEF, five bench. Greedy is optimal here because slot eligibility nests.
basis.strength: Per-slot and per-position rank against the other eleven teams. K and DEF are reported but never graded — they are streaming positions in this format.
basis.surplus: A bench player's "starts on N" is measured by recomputing each of the other eleven optimal lineups with him inserted.
basis.trades: Exhaustive 1-for-1 and 2-for-1 search. A proposal ships only if BOTH optimal lineups rise (>= 5 season points for a 1-for-1; >= 8 to me and >= 5 to them for a 2-for-1, where the other side must also take on more raw projected points than it gives).
basis.tendencies: The Panther Pit is in its first season, so there is no owner history to read. The league table reports completed moves this season instead — observed, and zero for everybody until somebody makes one.
basis.caveat: A projection is a season-long point estimate. It cannot see a camp role change, it prices DEF poorly (points-allowed tiers do not project), and it says nothing about week-to-week ceiling. Every number here is the start of an argument, not the end of one.

week.schedule_source: pairings from Sleeper's regular-season schedule, kickoff times from ESPN's public scoreboard
week.projection_source: Sleeper week-1 projected stat lines re-scored with The Panther Pit's exact scoring_settings — the same arithmetic as the season column, over a different stat line.
week.result_source: The Panther Pit's own week-1 matchup rows — Sleeper's scoring of each player in this league's settings, read as published rather than recomputed here.
